history.changes: The roles are the system's seven — Rhea Designer, Tenant Owner, Office Manager, Company Manager, User, Guest, Rhea Support — for the contract with Rhea and the technical setup; what a person does in the books is their groups'. A group says what its members may do; a person or another group joins it between two dates. Every company has four groups from the start: Chief Accountant, Accountant, Reader, and All users, which Rhea keeps. Grants already made under the roles of v3 read as what they became: owner as Company Manager, support as Rhea Support, chief accountant, accountant and reader as a User in the group of that name.
Written as an App, People: who may do what, its kinds of record, the who-can-do-what screen, its doors and rules. No definition changes; what is approved is the App itself.

Who may do what, as data: a role is a named set of rights; a membership puts a person in a company with a role between two dates; a mandate lets an office keep a client's books within a scope of rights; a substitution hands a person's rights to a deputy between two dates; a group names a set of people for a supervisor's reach. The pack's roles: owner, chief accountant, accountant, reader, support. The view that shows who can do what, every right opening to the grant that gives it.
A person can say their given name, family name and birth date — what a natural person's tax return needs.
The person as master data: who acts, who is assigned work, who stands in when they are away.

description: People: the person as master data — who acts, who is assigned, who stands in — and who may do what: the system's roles, groups, memberships, mandates, substitutions. Market-neutral; every pack that assigns work builds on it. v5: the roles are the system's, the business is groups (KK, 2026-10-27).

citations: every ERP keeps the people who use it as master data: a user with a role, and a substitute for absence (SAP workflow substitutes, Comarch operators)
every event in Rhea already names its actor; a person is that actor as an object, so cases, notifications and disputes can refer to a human the way documents refer to a contractor

KSeF 2.0's rights ladder: the taxpayer holds every right, grants named rights to people and to an authorised entity (the accounting office) with or without the right to pass them on; the office grants its employees rights in the client's context — Rhea's membership, mandate and role are those three
the right to manage rights is never implied by the right to do the work (KSeF: zarządzanie uprawnieniami is its own grant): a wildcard over doors stops at the people domain

payload.name: rhea_designer
payload.rights: view:* type:* door:approve_bundle door:reject_bundle door:declare_group door:join_group door:leave_group
payload.description: Designs Apps and runs the interviews: sees the company, releases its Apps, keeps its groups; books nothing

payload.name: tenant_owner
payload.description: Owns the tenant's contract with Rhea: says who is in; sees no books by this role alone

payload.name: office_manager
payload.description: Runs an accounting office: its parameters, master data and people

payload.name: company_manager
payload.description: Owns a company, an accounting office's client or not: everything, including who may do what

payload.name: user
payload.description: Works in Rhea: what they do is their groups'

payload.name: guest
payload.description: From outside the company: what they do is their groups'

payload.name: rhea_support
payload.description: Rhea's own staff: approve Rhea's shared rules; in a company's books by its timed grant alone, never who may do what

payload.name: chief_accountant
payload.description: Keeps the books whole and says who is in the company — the chief accountant's role of v3
payload.rights: door:* view:* type:* door:register_person door:appoint_deputy door:set_person_status door:identify_person door:grant_membership door:end_membership door:grant_mandate door:end_mandate door:appoint_substitute door:end_substitution

payload.name: accountant
payload.description: Keeps the books: every door, view and type; never who may do what

payload.name: all_users
payload.description: Everyone let into the company, a guest apart — Rhea keeps it; nobody is put into it
